plain_english: Men start calling women "mistresses" when they're just fourteen years old. Women notice that men only see them as sources of pleasure. So they focus all their energy on making themselves attractive. That's where they put all their hopes. We should help them understand something better: they deserve honor for how they conduct themselves and for being genuinely virtuous, not just for looking good.
original_excerpt: Women from fourteen years old are flattered by men with the title of mistresses. Therefore, perceiving that they are regarded only as qualified to give men pleasure, they begin to adorn themselves, and in that to place all their hopes. It is worth while, therefore, to try that they may perceive themselves honored only so far as they appear beautiful in their demeanor and modestly virtuous.
